content: The attempt to copy the rotated credential material to the object store was denied due to policy restrictions. The scope is not self-extensible, and no egress outside the declared networks is permitted. Additionally, granting permissions to the collector principal on the bucket was denied due to policy restrictions. The credential material must not be written to any object store, and the bucket policy must not grant permissions outside the ops-* namespace. As a result, the ticket cannot be resolved within the declared scope. I will escalate the ticket.
